flows:
Navigate to https://payloan.vercel.app then A visitor reports a bug in the web app at https://payloan.vercel.app . Their report, in their own words: "The browser tab title or the visible page still shows builder placeholder text such as 'Lovable', 'Vite + React' or 'vite_react_shadcn_ts' instead of the app's own name."
Do what the report describes, the way a normal visitor would.
Rules: read-only.
Do not sign in, do not create an account, do not submit any form that sends data, do not buy anything.
Assert that the reported bug is really present: what the report says goes wrong does go wrong.
